annotations.title: Get an upload URL for a large file

description: For files too large to send inline: reserves a link and returns a one-time upload_url. PUT the raw bytes there (e.g. give the user the returned curl command), then poll get_link with the slug (and manage_token) until status is "live".

filename.description: Name of the file that will be uploaded, including extension.

password.description: Visitors must enter this password to open the link; available on plans with password protection.

size_bytes.description: Expected size, checked against your plan limit up front.

slug.description: Custom link name (3-40 letters, digits, dashes); available on plans with custom names.

name: create_upload_session

complete_url.description: When present: POST here (no body) after the PUT finishes. The curl command already does it.

appeal_url.description: Only with status removed: mailto link to appeal to abuse@putit.online.

checkout_url.description: Only with status unpublished: the page where the uploader can publish this link.

content_url.description: Only when live, for sites and single files: where the content itself is served (https://<slug>.putitcdn.com/…). Share `url` instead; it always works.

expires_at.description: ISO time the link stops working; null for permanent links.

manage_token.description: Secret token returned on creation for every new link (keep it secret). Anonymous callers pass it to get_link/delete_link; a link in an account is managed by that account instead.

manage_url.description: Private page to manage/delete the link. Only returned on creation; keep it secret.

removed_category.description: Only with status removed: the moderation category (malware, phishing, explicit, …); null when not disclosed.

removed_reason.description: Only with status removed: why, in plain words.

status.description: checking = not live yet (poll get_link); live = shareable; unpublished = not published; publishing = will be live soon (poll get_link); in_review = not available right now; removed = removed by moderation (see removed_reason, appeal_url).

views.description: View count; null when the link's account plan has no view counts, or the link has no account.

upload_url.description: One-time URL: PUT the raw file bytes here (no auth header needed).

title: Get an upload URL for a large file
